description: Explains why a tool call was allowed, noted or blocked: the client's tool-call checks, the witness's ruling (allow or block, mode, basis), the rules that matched, the rule set version, the fields that were not disclosed, and how to allow the call. Pass the record hash (or its first 8 or more characters) of the call's decision or outcome, from signafaide_records. Pass pack to read a verification pack instead of the local records. Read-only: it reads local files, makes no request and changes nothing. It never prints a disclosed value, only field pointers, rule ids, codes and versions. It does not re-verify the record (use signafaide_verify); to see all the rules held, use signafaide_show_rules.

directory.description: Path of the project to work on: the folder the MCP server was started in, or one below it. Default: that folder.

pack.description: Path of a verification pack (from `signafaide export` or an auditor link) to read the record from, instead of the local records.

record.description: A record hash, or its first 8 or more characters: a decision or its outcome.

name: signafaide_explain_ruling
title: Explain a signafAIde ruling on a tool call
